title: Gyrados POKEMON POKEDEX Sticker EF #130-131 LAPRAS Edition 2022
categoryName: Collectibles:Animation Art & Merchandise:Animation Merchandise:Other Animation Merchandise
descriptionText:
This rare Pokemon sticker features Gyrados and Lapras in stunning multicolor design. It's a must-have for any Pokemon fan, especially those who love anime and manga. The sticker is part of the Pokemon POKEDEX series and is an official Nintendo product. 

With its intricate details and vibrant colors, this sticker is perfect for collecting or decorating your laptop or phone. Show off your love for the Pokemon franchise with this unique and highly sought-after sticker. Don't miss your chance to own a piece of Pokemon history!
